tickets_solved_fields_match_status.name: tickets_solved_fields_match_status
tickets_solved_fields_match_status.value: ("tickets"."status" = 'solved') = ("tickets"."solved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."solved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

calls_recording_fields_match_status.name: calls_recording_fields_match_status
calls_recording_fields_match_status.value: ("calls"."recording_status" = 'stored') = ("calls"."recording_key" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."recording_content_type" IS NOT NULL)

calls_decision_fields_match_status.name: calls_decision_fields_match_status
calls_decision_fields_match_status.value: ("calls"."analysis_status" = 'decided') = ("calls"."ai_outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."ai_decision_source" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."ai_reason_code" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('simple', lower(normalize("heading", NFKC) COLLATE "und-x-icu")), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', lower(normalize("text", NFKC) COLLATE "und-x-icu")), 'B')

holding_reply.name: holding_reply
holding_reply.default: 'Thank you for your message. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.'

assistant_settings_autopost_enabler.name: assistant_settings_autopost_enabler
assistant_settings_autopost_enabler.value: "assistant_settings"."autopost_enabled" = ("assistant_settings"."autopost_enabled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_settings"."autopost_enabled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT "assistant_settings"."autopost_enabled" OR "assistant_settings"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL)

assistant_settings_hours_with_time_zone.name: assistant_settings_hours_with_time_zone
assistant_settings_hours_with_time_zone.value: ("assistant_settings"."opening_hours" IS NULL OR "assistant_settings"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL) AND ("assistant_settings"."away_hours" IS NULL OR "assistant_settings"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL)

telegram_link_codes_claim_fields_togethe.name: telegram_link_codes_claim_fields_together
telegram_link_codes_claim_fields_togethe.value: num_nonnulls("telegram_link_codes"."claimed_by_telegram_id", "telegram_link_codes"."claimed_at") IN (0, 2) AND ("telegram_link_codes"."used_at" IS NULL OR "telegram_link_codes"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL)

content_drafts_idea_has_no_content.name: content_drafts_idea_has_no_content
content_drafts_idea_has_no_content.value: "content_drafts"."status" <> 'idea' OR ("content_drafts"."title" = '' AND "content_drafts"."body" = '' AND "content_drafts"."call_to_action" = '' AND "content_drafts"."image_prompt" = '' AND "content_drafts"."video_script" = '' AND cardinality("content_drafts"."hashtags") = 0 AND "content_drafts"."media_asset_id" IS NULL)

content_drafts_acknowledgment_with_appro.name: content_drafts_acknowledgment_with_approval
content_drafts_acknowledgment_with_appro.value: "content_drafts"."claims_acknowledged_at" IS NULL OR "content_drafts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL

content_drafts_rejection_note_with_rejec.name: content_drafts_rejection_note_with_rejection
content_drafts_rejection_note_with_rejec.value: "content_drafts"."rejection_note" IS NULL OR "content_drafts"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL

media_assets_storage_key_from_ids.name: media_assets_storage_key_from_ids
media_assets_storage_key_from_ids.value: "media_assets"."storage_key" = 'media/' || "media_assets"."company_id"::text || '/' || "media_assets"."id"::text || '.' || CASE "media_assets"."content_type" WHEN 'image/png' THEN 'png' WHEN 'image/jpeg' THEN 'jpg' WHEN 'image/webp' THEN 'webp' WHEN 'image/gif' THEN 'gif' WHEN 'video/mp4' THEN 'mp4' END

media_assets_upload_fields.name: media_assets_upload_fields
media_assets_upload_fields.value: "media_assets"."source" <> 'upload' OR ("media_assets"."original_name" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."generation_job_id" IS NULL AND "media_assets"."provider" IS NULL)

media_assets_generated_fields.name: media_assets_generated_fields
media_assets_generated_fields.value: "media_assets"."source" <> 'generated' OR ("media_assets"."original_name" IS NULL AND "media_assets"."generation_job_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."provider" IS NOT NULL)

media_generation_jobs_succeeded_has_asse.name: media_generation_jobs_succeeded_has_asset
media_generation_jobs_succeeded_has_asse.value: "media_generation_jobs"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR "media_generation_jobs"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL OR "media_generation_jobs"."asset_deleted_at" IS NOT NULL

media_generation_jobs_asset_deleted_fiel.name: media_generation_jobs_asset_deleted_fields
media_generation_jobs_asset_deleted_fiel.value: "media_generation_jobs"."asset_deleted_at" IS NULL OR ("media_generation_jobs"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "media_generation_jobs"."asset_id" IS NULL)

social_connections_kind_fits_platform.name: social_connections_kind_fits_platform
social_connections_kind_fits_platform.value: ("social_connections"."platform" = 'linkedin' AND "social_connections"."account_kind" IN ('member', 'page')) OR ("social_connections"."platform" = 'facebook' AND "social_connections"."account_kind" = 'page') OR ("social_connections"."platform" = 'x' AND "social_connections"."account_kind" = 'account') OR ("social_connections"."platform" = 'youtube' AND "social_connections"."account_kind" = 'channel')

social_connections_connected_has_token.name: social_connections_connected_has_token
social_connections_connected_has_token.value: "social_connections"."status" <> 'connected' OR ("social_connections"."access_token_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "social_connections"."disconnected_at" IS NULL)

social_connections_disconnected_fields.name: social_connections_disconnected_fields
social_connections_disconnected_fields.value: ("social_connections"."status" = 'disconnected') = ("social_connections"."disconnected_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("social_connections"."status" <> 'disconnected' OR ("social_connections"."access_token_encrypted" IS NULL AND "social_connections"."refresh_token_encrypted" IS NULL AND "social_connections"."access_expires_at" IS NULL AND "social_connections"."refresh_expires_at" IS NULL))

social_connections_refresh_expiry_with_t.name: social_connections_refresh_expiry_with_token
social_connections_refresh_expiry_with_t.value: "social_connections"."refresh_expires_at" IS NULL OR "social_connections"."refresh_token_encrypted" IS NOT NULL

autopublish_rules_enabled_fields.name: autopublish_rules_enabled_fields
autopublish_rules_enabled_fields.value: "autopublish_rules"."enabled" = ("autopublish_rules"."enabled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "autopublish_rules"."enabled" = ("autopublish_rules"."enabled_at" IS NOT NULL)

publish_jobs_problem_has_error.name: publish_jobs_problem_has_error
publish_jobs_problem_has_error.value: "publish_jobs"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'needs_attention') OR "publish_jobs"."last_error" IS NOT NULL

publish_jobs_post_only_when_published.name: publish_jobs_post_only_when_published
publish_jobs_post_only_when_published.value: ("publish_jobs"."external_post_id" IS NULL AND "publish_jobs"."external_url" IS NULL) OR "publish_jobs"."status" = 'published'

publish_jobs_metrics_error_with_attempt.name: publish_jobs_metrics_error_with_attempt
publish_jobs_metrics_error_with_attempt.value: "publish_jobs"."metrics_error" IS NULL OR "publish_jobs"."metrics_attempted_at" IS NOT NULL

post_metrics_counts_not_negative.name: post_metrics_counts_not_negative
post_metrics_counts_not_negative.value: "post_metrics"."views" >= 0 AND "post_metrics"."reach" >= 0 AND "post_metrics"."reactions" >= 0 AND "post_metrics"."comments" >= 0 AND "post_metrics"."shares" >= 0 AND "post_metrics"."clicks" >= 0 AND "post_metrics"."video_views" >= 0

orders_number_once_placed.name: orders_number_once_placed
orders_number_once_placed.value: ("orders"."status" = 'proposed') = ("orders"."order_number" IS NULL) AND ("orders"."order_number" IS NULL) = ("orders"."placed_at" IS NULL)

autopost_slots_draft_once_written.name: autopost_slots_draft_once_written
autopost_slots_draft_once_written.value: "autopost_slots"."status" NOT IN ('scheduled', 'waiting_approval') OR "autopost_slots"."draft_id" IS NOT NULL
